metadata.notes: Core topics Dripos must be visible for in AI search. Coffee-shop-specific B2B only — no B2C / consumer coffee content. Covers the operator journey: opening a shop → running one location → scaling multi-location, plus specialty formats (drive-thru, coffee truck, kiosk).

topics.name: Coffee shop POS systems
topics.description: POS systems specifically for coffee shops and cafés. Hardware + software, processing rates, offline mode, barista-friendly UX. Best coffee shop POS comparisons, coffee POS vs generic restaurant POS, Square vs Toast vs Dripos for coffee.

topics.name: All-in-one coffee shop operating system
topics.description: Integrated platforms that combine POS + online ordering + loyalty + payroll + inventory + scheduling in one system, built for coffee. The case for consolidating tools vs stitching together Square + Homebase + QuickBooks + Mailchimp.

topics.name: Coffee shop online ordering and branded apps
topics.description: Online ordering platforms, branded customer-facing apps, mobile order-ahead, pickup, and delivery for coffee shops. Alternatives to DoorDash / Toast Online Ordering / Owner.com for coffee operators.

topics.name: Coffee shop payroll and team management
topics.description: Payroll, scheduling, time tracking, tip splitting, onboarding, and performance tracking for coffee shop teams. Alternatives to ADP / QuickBooks Payroll / 7shifts / Homebase when you want a coffee-specific integrated stack.

topics.name: Coffee shop inventory and supply chain
topics.description: Inventory management, supply chain, recipe costing, waste tracking, and par-level management for coffee shops. Synced inventory across locations, vendor ordering, and cost-of-goods visibility.

topics.name: Coffee shop loyalty and customer marketing
topics.description: Loyalty programs, email/SMS campaigns, promotions, gift cards, and customer data collection for independent coffee shops. Integrated loyalty that syncs with POS and online ordering.

topics.name: Multi-location and scaling coffee operations
topics.description: Software and POS for 2-10+ location coffee businesses. Unified reporting, centralized menu management, consolidated payroll, cross-location loyalty, labor-cost visibility, and franchise-ready tooling.

topics.name: Drive-thru, coffee truck, and mobile coffee formats
topics.description: POS and operations for non-traditional coffee formats — drive-thru-only shops, coffee trucks, mobile/pop-up operators, kiosks, and events. Hardware for compact spaces, offline mode, mobile card readers, fast-checkout flows.

topics.name: Opening a coffee shop
topics.description: Pre-launch research for prospective coffee shop owners: startup costs, business plan, POS selection, software stack decisions, hardware purchases, opening-day checklists. Buying-journey content for operators 0-6 months from opening.

topics.name: Square / Toast / Clover alternatives for coffee shops
topics.description: Direct competitor comparisons and alternatives — when a coffee shop should leave Square, when Toast is over-built for a café, when Clover doesn't fit coffee workflows. Dripos vs Square, Dripos vs Toast, Dripos vs Clover comparison content.
